# PROPPS PTY LTD

> PROPPS PTY LTD is Australia's premier provider of cinema-grade reproduction currency and prop cash, engineered strictly in compliance with Crimes (Currency) Act 1981 Section 22 guidelines for film, television, theatre, advertising, and simulation arts.

## Identity & Verification
- Brand: PROPPS PTY LTD
- Location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
- Founding: 2019
- Compliance: Crimes (Currency) Act 1981 Section 22 Specimen Notes
- Disclaimers: Non-legal tender, artistic simulation, film production and training use only.

## Key Ordering Rules
- Minimum Order: $150 AUD
- Free Express Shipping: $500 AUD and above via Australia Post Express with signature on delivery
- Flat Shipping: $20 AUD under $500
- Crypto Discount: 10% instant deduction on Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum
- Checkout Channels: WhatsApp direct checkout and Email order checkout

## Prop Categories
- [New Notes](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/new-notes/): From $115 AUD - AU prop money for film, TV and photography: our current-series Australian prop notes across all five denominations, printed double-sided on premium archival paper.
- [Film & TV Props](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/film-and-tv-props/): From $115 AUD - Buy film props for Australian productions: cinema and television prop currency engineered for on-camera realism under studio lighting.
- [Money Stacks](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/money-stacks/): From $115 AUD - Prop money stacks for scenes that need large visible cash volumes: bulk strapped stacks and bundles in every denomination.
- [Photography Props](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/photography-props/): From $115 AUD - Photography props Australia photographers use for cash shots: prop currency styled for print, editorial and commercial shoots.
- [Event & Party Props](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/event-and-party-props/): From $115 AUD - Play money Australia families, schools and event planners buy: clearly marked novelty prop cash for parties, themed events and entertainment.
- [Custom & Branded Props](https://proppsptyltd.com.au/shop/custom-and-branded-props/): From $115 AUD - Custom prop money for agencies, brands and special productions: bespoke branded prop currency made to your artwork and specimen-marked.
